crossRefs.note: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria…
Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

translations.web: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
translations.bsb: “Give me this power as well,” he said, “so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”
translations.kjv: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
translations.asv: saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay my hands, he may receive the Holy Spirit.
